paite: Huchi in Judah mi tengteng in kum sawm-le-guk a upa Uzziah api ua, apa Amaziah sik in kumpipa ding in abawlta uhi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa Uzziah / (2 Kum 14.21,22; 15.1-7)
english: All the people of Judah took Uzziah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the place of his father Amaziah.

paite: Ama'n kumpipa api-le-pute kiang a a-ihmut nung in Eloth khua abawlhoih a, Judah gam ah apangsak nawn hi.
english: He built Eloth and restored it to Judah. After that the king slept with his fathers.

paite: Uzziah in vaihawm apat tung in kum sawm-le-guk a upa ahi a, Jerusalem ah kum sawmnga-le-nih vai ahawm a, anu min Jekoliah, Jerusalem mi ahi.
english: Uzziah was sixteen years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jechiliah, of Jerusalem.

paite: Apa Amaziah thilhih bangbang hih sam in TOUPA mitmuh in thil hoihtak ahih zel hi.
english: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.

paite: Pathian kilakna theisiam Zekariah damsung in Pathian zong ding in akibawl tinten hi. Pathian azon sung teng in Pathian in alamzangsak hi.
english: He set himself to seek God in the days of Zechariah, who had understanding in the vision of God; and as long as he sought Yahweh, God made him prosper.

paite: Philistiate sim ding in akuankhia a, Gath kulhte, Jabneh kulh, Ashdod kulh ahihchim a; huchi in Ashdod gam ah leh Philistiate lak ah khua abawl hi.
english: He went out and fought against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in the country of Ashdod, and among the Philistines.

paite: Huchi in Pathian in Philistiate lak ah leh Gurbaal a om Arabiate leh Meuni mite lak ah apanpih hi.
english: God helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.

paite: Ammonte'n Uzziah lak ah siah aliau sek ua; huchi in ahong hat mahmah ziak un Aigupta gam tan in aminthangta uhi.
english: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziah. His name spread abroad even to the entrance of Egypt, for he grew exceedingly strong.

paite: Uzziah in Jerusalem ah aning ah kongpi, Phaizang kongpi, kulh kawina lai kongpi, insangte, alam lai a, kulh in a-um hi.
english: Moreover Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate, at the valley gate, and at the turning of the wall, and fortified them.

paite: Gamdai ah leng insang alam a, gam tampi aneih ziak in tuilehte atoukhia a, phailam leh phaizang ah ganhon anei a; lounei mite leh uain suk mite tang lam leh gam hoihte ah akoih a, amah louma lam limsakmi tak ahi.
english: He built towers in the wilderness, and dug out many cisterns, for he had much livestock, both in the lowlands and in the plains. He had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields, for he loved farming.

paite: Uzziah in sepaih kidoumi kumpipa sepaih heutu Hanani nuai a mi laigelhmi Jeiel leh heutu Maaseiahte'n aseh bang zel ua apawlpawl a galkapmi anei lai hi.
english: Moreover Uzziah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king’s captains.

paite: Mihat hangsan chiat, a-inkuan upate tengteng sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
english: The whole number of the heads of fathers’ households, even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand six hundred.

paite: Anuai uah sepaih sinsiamsa ngen nuaithum sangsagih-le-zanga melma lak a kumpipa panpihmi galsualmi taktak a-om uhi.
english: Under their hand was an army, three hundred seven thousand five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.

paite: Huchi in Uzziah in sepaih tengteng a ding in lum, tei, sik lukhu, sik puanak, thalpeu leh vaisuanglot a ding in suangte akisakhol hi.
english: Uzziah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, spears, helmets, coats of mail, bows, and stones for slinging.

paite: Jerusalem ah mipilte theihkhiak khawlte abawl a, insang leh kulh ning chih ah thalkapna leh suang lian kuamkuam ana denna ding akoih a; amin gam chih mual chih ah athangta a; ahat mahmah tan in alam a lamdangtak a panpih in a-om hi.
english: In Jerusalem, he made devices, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad, because he was marvelously helped until he was strong.

paite: Himahleh ahong hat nung in alungsim ahong sang a, hoih lou hial in thil ahih a, TOUPA a Pathian tung ah thil ahihkhial a; gimlim maitam a gimlim hal ding in TOUPA tempul ah alut hi.
heading: Uzziah Sawi A Omna
english: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against Yahweh his God, for he went into Yahweh’s temple to burn incense on the altar of incense.

paite: Huchi in siampu Azariah in azui a, mihangsantak TOUPA siampu sawmgiat atel uhi.
english: Azariah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of Yahweh, who were valiant men.

paite: Kumpipa Uzziah akhou ua akiang ah, "Uzziah aw, TOUPA a ding a gimlim hal nang hih ding ahi kei, gimlim hal ding a sehtuam Aaron tapa siampute hih ding ahi zaw hi; mun siangthou a kipan pawtkhia in; thil na hihkhial hi; TOUPA Pathian a pan na thupina ding ahi kei," achi uhi.
english: They resisted Uzziah the king, and said to him, “It isn’t for you, Uzziah, to burn incense to Yahweh, but for the priests the sons of Aaron, who are consecrated to burn incense. Go out of the sanctuary, for you have trespassed. It will not be for your honor from Yahweh God.”

paite: Huan Uzziah ahehta a; gimlim halna ding mei lakna atawi a, huchi a siampute tung a aheh laitak in TOUPA' inn ah, gimlim halna chin ah siampute ma ah atal ahong phakkheta hi.
english: Then Uzziah was angry. He had a censer in his hand to burn incense, and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke out on his forehead before the priests in Yahweh’s house, beside the altar of incense.

paite: Huchi in siampu heutu Azariah leh siampu tengteng in a-en ua, ngai in, atal ahong phak a, huai a kipan in avikkhe pah ua, ahi, TOUPA'N agawt ziak in amah leng kintak in apawtkheta hi.
english: Azariah the chief priest and all the priests looked at him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead; and they thrust him out quickly from there. Indeed, he himself also hurried to go out, because Yahweh had struck him.

paite: Kumpipa Uzziah bel asih ni tan in aphakta a, aphak ziak in a-inn tuam ah a-omta hi. TOUPA' inn a kipan hihkhiak in a-omta a, huchi in atapa Jotham bel agam ua mite vaihawm in kumpipa' inn a ukpa ding in a-omta hi.
english: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from Yahweh’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

paite: Uzziah thilhih dang tengteng bel abul a kipan a atawp pha in Amoz tapa zawlnei Isai in agelh hi.
english: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziah, first and last, Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, wrote.

paite: Huchi in Uzziah bel api leh apute kiang ah a-ihmu a, kumpipa kivuina mun a api leh apute lak ah avui uhi. "Amah zaw phak ahi ngal a," achi ua, huchi in asik in atapa Jotham in vai ahawmta hi.
english: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.
